response.overview: Jack, a grieving young man, seeks solace in Echo, a new company that uses advanced technology to simulate interactions with the deceased. Through the simulation, Jack reconnects with Fiona, whose resurrected presence offers comfort but also begins to expose buried secrets from their shared past. As the process grows disturbingly real, Jack becomes consumed by his need for answers, crossing boundaries and violating Fiona’s privacy even after her death.
response.title: The Echo Experience
